Maintain candidate indexes whose values decrease from front to back. When a new value arrives, remove smaller candidates from the back, then remove the front index if it is outside the window.
Each index is enqueued and dequeued at most once, so the total cost is O(n); the front is the current window maximum.
维护容量为 K 的最小堆：堆顶是当前候选里最小的值。更大值到来时替换堆顶。\n整:
Maintain a min-heap of size K: the heap top is the smallest value among the current candidates. When a larger value arrives, replace the heap top.
The overall cost is usually O(n log K). If the final output must be ordered, an extra sort is needed.
